_note: What you see: The settings window of Pipelinq itself, at Email and calendar: an employee links their own mail and calendar to customers and sees when the last sync ran.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Het instellingenvenster van Pipelinq zelf, bij E-mail en agenda: een medewerker koppelt de eigen mail en agenda aan klanten en ziet wanneer er voor het laatst is gesynchroniseerd.
Staat dit aan, dan worden e-mails uit de: When this is on, emails from the chosen accounts are automatically linked to contacts in the CRM, by email address.
Gegevens over de e-mail (onderwerp, afze: Details about the email (subject, sender, date) are stored in the CRM. The full content is only read when you open it in Nextcloud Mail, and is visible only to you by default.
Koppel berichten uit Nextcloud Mail rege: Regularly link messages from Nextcloud Mail to your customers, contacts, leads and requests. The mail stays in Nextcloud Mail.
Kies uit welk Nextcloud Mail-account gel: Choose which Nextcloud Mail account is read. If you leave this empty, nothing is linked.
Berichten met deze afzender- of ontvange: Messages with these sender or recipient addresses are skipped.
Vervolgacties en afspraken uit Pipelinq: Follow-up actions and appointments from Pipelinq appear in your Nextcloud Calendar. Appointments with known contacts are linked to their profile in the CRM.
Afspraken komen in een eigen agenda Pipe: Appointments go into a separate calendar Pipelinq in your Nextcloud Calendar.
De synchronisatie met het adresboek staa: The sync with the address book is at the top of this section.
